titre: MOMOKOO MERGE - N.O.S Atelier - A drop-and-merge puzzle with six quirky little characters
chapo: Hi everyone! 👋 We're N.O.S Atelier, a creative studio from South Korea. Meet MOMOKOO MERGE, a colorful puzzle game featuring six quirky characters from our original MOMOKOO universe! Each MOMOKOO is born from a different kind of food. You are what you eat... literally! DROP! MERGE! GROW! POP! Merge matching MOMOKOOs, discover their unique POP effects, and have fun! We're also excited to share…
